title: Anybody want to start a group project?
author: SouthCentralMenace
selftext:
I have the $100 Codex subscription and they keep giving me so many resets that Im running out of things I want to build lol. If there is anybody else running out of ideas, I thought maybe a group of us could work together on something and see what comes of it. There seems to be a lot of people working independently, but I think we could get more creative ideas with a few minds coming together. Not to mention, we could deploy more agents that way.

If anybody is interested, let me know. I'd be happy to create a Discord channel and we could brainstorm from there. If not, no biggie, just thought I'd throw the idea out there. 

*If you aren't 18+, I ask that you don't join.*

comments.author: Monecreiff
comments.body: They just hit us again! I swear chat gpt is the best service out right now. They are literally resetting it seems like every other day

comments.body: They just hit us with another dose!

comments.body: I'm interested as well - have several projects on the go and would be good to brainstorm and connect with other people who are interested in building together.
